def _context(api, cluster):
    from .k8s import _BoundedPool
    client = getattr(getattr(api, 'api', api), 'api_client', None)
    configuration = getattr(client, 'configuration', None)
    pool = getattr(getattr(client, 'rest_client', None), 'pool_manager', None)
    host = getattr(configuration, 'host', None)
    if (not isinstance(pool, _BoundedPool) or not pool.server or not isinstance(host, str)
            or urlsplit(host) != pool.server or pool.server.scheme != 'https'
            or pool.server.username is not None or pool.server.password is not None
            or pool.server.query or pool.server.fragment or configuration.verify_ssl is not True
            or not callable(getattr(client, 'update_params_for_auth', None))):
        raise Incomplete('authenticated_bounded_transport_required')
    if configuration.debug or _wire_debug_enabled(pool.pool):
        raise Incomplete('unsafe_native_wire_debug')
    headers = dict(getattr(client, 'default_headers', {}) or {})
    query = []
    client.update_params_for_auth(headers, query, ['BearerToken'])
    authorization = next((v for k, v in headers.items() if k.lower() == 'authorization'), None)
    mutual_tls = bool(getattr(configuration, 'cert_file', None) and getattr(configuration, 'key_file', None))
    if query or (not mutual_tls and (not isinstance(authorization, str) or not authorization.strip())):
        raise Incomplete('authenticated_bounded_transport_required')
    binding = _fingerprint(json.dumps([host, cluster, authorization,
        getattr(configuration, 'cert_file', None), getattr(configuration, 'key_file', None)]))
    return client, pool, host, headers, binding

def _pod_identity(value, target, end):
    """Only typed identity/status is retained, never Pod annotations or literals."""
    try:
        if (not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get('apiVersion') != 'v1' or value.get('kind') != 'Pod'
                or any(k in value for k in ('_partial', '_coverage', '_representation'))):
            raise Incomplete('unbound_native_pod')
        meta, spec, status = value['metadata'], value['spec'], value['status']
        if (meta['namespace'] != target['namespace'] or meta['name'] != target['pod']
                or meta.get('deletionTimestamp') is not None):
            raise Incomplete('unbound_native_pod')
        if not isinstance(spec['containers'], list) or not 1 <= len(spec['containers']) <= 256:
            raise Incomplete('malformed_native_pod')
        uid, version = meta['uid'], meta['resourceVersion']
        if (not isinstance(uid, str) or str(UUID(uid)) != uid or not isinstance(version, str)
                or not 1 <= len(version) <= 128 or not version.isascii()
                or any(ord(c) < 33 or ord(c) > 126 for c in version)):
            raise Incomplete('unbound_native_pod')
        created = timestamp_ns(meta['creationTimestamp'])
        matches, seen = [], set()
        for field, statuses in (('containers', 'containerStatuses'), ('initContainers', 'initContainerStatuses'),
                ('ephemeralContainers', 'ephemeralContainerStatuses')):
            containers = spec.get(field, [])
            if not isinstance(containers, list) or len(containers) > 256:
                raise Incomplete('malformed_native_container')
            for container in containers:
                name = container['name']
                if not isinstance(name, str) or not _LABEL.fullmatch(name) or name in seen:
                    raise Incomplete('ambiguous_native_container')
                seen.add(name)
                if name == target['container']:
                    entries = status[statuses]
                    if not isinstance(entries, list) or len(entries) > 256:
                        raise Incomplete('malformed_native_container')
                    entry, = [s for s in entries if s['name'] == name]
                    matches.append((field, entry))
        family, entry = matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else (None, None)
        if entry is None:
            raise Incomplete('unbound_native_container')
        restart, container_id, state = entry['restartCount'], entry['containerID'], entry['state']
        if (type(restart) is not int or not 0 <= restart <= 2147483647 or not isinstance(container_id, str)
                or not 1 <= len(container_id) <= 512
                or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9][a-z0-9+.-]*://[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+', container_id)
                or not isinstance(state, dict) or len(state) != 1):
            raise Incomplete('unbound_native_container')
        running = 'running' in state
        detail = state.get('running' if running else 'terminated')
        started = timestamp_ns(detail['startedAt'])
        finished = None if running else timestamp_ns(detail['finishedAt'])
        if (not created <= started <= end or finished is not None and not started <= finished <= end
                or not running and (type(detail.get('exitCode')) is not int
                    or detail.get('containerID', container_id) != container_id)):
            raise Incomplete('incoherent_container_time')
        return uid, version, family, restart, container_id, started, finished
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError, IndexError):
        raise Incomplete('unbound_native_pod_or_container') from None

def evaluate(item, index):
    try:
        ctx = index['context']
        scope, metadata = ctx['scope'], ctx['metadata']
        if ctx['provider'] != 'k8s' or metadata[KIND + '_authorized'] is not True:
            raise ValueError('authorization')
        own, = [r for r in index['collections'][KIND] if r.get('scope') == scope]
        if own['status'] not in ('collected', 'partial') or not isinstance(own['items'], list):
            raise ValueError('collection')
        all_selected = metadata[KIND + '_selection']
        selected = all_selected[scope]
        if (not isinstance(all_selected, dict) or any(not isinstance(v, list) for v in all_selected.values())
                or not 1 <= sum(len(v) for v in all_selected.values()) <= 4
                or len(set(v for ids in all_selected.values() for v in ids)) != sum(len(v) for v in all_selected.values())
                or not isinstance(selected, list) or not 1 <= len(selected) <= 4
                or any(not isinstance(v, str) or re.fullmatch(KIND + ':[0-9a-f]{64}', v) is None for v in selected)
                or {r['id'] for r in own['items']} != set(selected) or len(own['items']) != len(selected)
                or sum(r == item for r in own['items']) != 1):
            raise ValueError('selection')
        capture = metadata[KIND + '_capture']
        if (not isinstance(capture, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'k8s-log-capture:[0-9a-f-]{36}', capture)
                or str(UUID(capture[16:])) != capture[16:] or UUID(capture[16:]).version != 4):
            raise ValueError('capture')
        window = metadata[KIND + '_window']
        if not isinstance(window, list) or len(window) != 2:
            raise ValueError('window')
        start, end = map(timestamp_ns, window)
        if end - start != WINDOW_SECONDS * 1_000_000_000:
            raise ValueError('window')
        # The immutable capture remains valid offline; freshness is relative to
        # snapshot creation, never the evaluator's unbound current wall clock.
        created = ctx['created_at']
        if not end <= timestamp_ns(created) <= end + (MAX_SECONDS + 15) * 1_000_000_000:
            raise ValueError('capture time')
        marker, ident = item[MARKER], item['id']
        if (set(marker) != {'schema', 'identity', 'capture', 'scope', 'cluster_binding', 'complete', 'native_bound',
                'reason', 'verification', 'source_requests', 'parts', 'leaks', 'lines', 'sample_bytes',
                'first_ns', 'last_ns', 'uid_binding', 'version_binding', 'container_binding', 'context_binding'}
                or marker['schema'] != SCHEMA or marker['identity'] != ident or marker['scope'] != scope
                or marker['capture'] != capture or marker['native_bound'] is not True
                or type(marker['complete']) is not bool
                or not marker['complete'] and own['status'] != 'partial'
                or marker['reason'] != ('complete' if marker['complete'] else 'detectors_incomplete')
                or marker['verification'] != 'not_attempted'
                or marker['cluster_binding'] != metadata[KIND + '_cluster_binding']
                or any(not _digest(marker[k]) for k in ('cluster_binding', 'uid_binding', 'version_binding', 'container_binding', 'context_binding'))
                or type(marker['lines']) is not int or not 1 <= marker['lines'] <= TAIL_LINES
                or type(marker['sample_bytes']) is not int or not 1 <= marker['sample_bytes'] < MAX_LOG
                or type(marker['first_ns']) is not int or type(marker['last_ns']) is not int
                or not start <= marker['first_ns'] <= marker['last_ns'] <= end):
            raise ValueError('marker')
        refs, ledger = marker['source_requests'], metadata[KIND + '_receipts']
        if (not isinstance(refs, list) or len(refs) != 3 or len(set(refs)) != 3
                or not isinstance(ledger, list) or not 3 <= len(ledger) <= 12
                or len({r['id'] for r in ledger}) != len(ledger)):
            raise ValueError('receipts')
        bindings = []
        for ref, ordinal in zip(refs, (1, 2, 3)):
            receipt, = [r for r in ledger if r.get('id') == ref]
            if (not isinstance(ref, str) or re.fullmatch(r'k8s-log-read-[1-9][0-9]*', ref) is None
                    or set(receipt) != {'id', 'identity', 'scope', 'capture', 'method', 'route', 'status', 'bytes',
                        'ordinal', 'context_binding', 'request_binding'}
                    or receipt['identity'] != ident or receipt['scope'] != scope or receipt['capture'] != capture
                    or receipt['method'] != 'GET' or type(receipt['status']) is not int or receipt['status'] != 200
                    or type(receipt['ordinal']) is not int or receipt['ordinal'] != ordinal
                    or receipt['context_binding'] != marker['context_binding'] or not _digest(receipt['request_binding'])
                    or receipt['route'] != ('exact_selected_current_log' if ordinal == 2 else 'exact_selected_pod')
                    or type(receipt['bytes']) is not int or not 1 <= receipt['bytes'] <= (MAX_LOG if ordinal == 2 else MAX_POD)
                    or ordinal == 2 and receipt['bytes'] != marker['sample_bytes']):
                raise ValueError('receipt')
            bindings.append(receipt['request_binding'])
        if bindings[0] != bindings[2] or bindings[0] == bindings[1]:
            raise ValueError('request coherence')
        part, = marker['parts']
        if (set(part) != {'part', 'bytes', 'engines', 'complete'} or part['part'] != 'log_sample'
                or type(part['complete']) is not bool or part['complete'] != marker['complete']
                or type(part['bytes']) is not int or not 1 <= part['bytes'] <= MAX_LOG + 4096):
            raise ValueError('part')
        versions = {'kingfisher': KINGFISHER_VERSION, 'trufflehog': TRUFFLEHOG_VERSION}
        engines = part['engines']
        if (not isinstance(engines, list) or len(engines) != 2
                or any(not isinstance(e, dict) or set(e) != {'engine', 'version', 'status'}
                    or e['engine'] not in versions or e['version'] != versions[e['engine']]
                    or e['status'] not in ('complete', 'unavailable') for e in engines)
                or {e['engine'] for e in engines} != set(versions)):
            raise ValueError('engines')
        completed = {e['engine'] for e in engines if e['status'] == 'complete'}
        if not completed or marker['complete'] != (completed == set(versions)):
            raise ValueError('completion')
        leaks = marker['leaks']
        if (not isinstance(leaks, list) or len(leaks) > MAX_LEAKS or merge_leaks(leaks) != leaks
                or sum(len(l['locations']) for l in leaks) > MAX_LOCATIONS
                or any(d['engine'] not in completed for l in leaks for d in l['detectors'])
                or any(set(loc) - {'path', 'line'} or loc['path'] != ident + '.log_sample'
                    or 'line' in loc and not 1 <= loc['line'] <= marker['lines'] + 2
                    for l in leaks for loc in l['locations'])):
            raise ValueError('leaks')
        complete = marker['complete'] and own['status'] == 'collected'
        if not leaks and not complete:
            raise ValueError('incomplete absence')
        observed = ('A likely secret was detected in a selected current-container log sample or its bound identity text; the value is hidden and was not validated.' if leaks else
            'Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in the selected current-container sample and bound identity text. Coverage is limited to the returned sample of at most 100 lines within the fixed preceding hour.')
        if not complete:
            observed += ' Coverage is incomplete; a completed detector still reported this secret.'
        return ('FAIL' if leaks else 'PASS'), {'observed': observed, 'secret_leaks': deepcopy(leaks),
            'complete': complete, 'credential_validation': 'not_attempted', 'coverage': 'selected_current_container_sample_only',
            'parts': deepcopy(marker['parts']), 'source_requests': list(refs), 'sample_lines': marker['lines']}
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError, OverflowError):
        return 'UNKNOWN', {'observed': 'The selected current-container log sample was disabled, unavailable, incomplete or unbound. Secret absence could not be assessed.'}

source_lineage.shared_observation_limit: These are current dependency observations, not a whole-file freeze or permission to edit shared files. Root owns actual atomic admission/hook successors.

per_id.actual_native_path: Official SDK update_params_for_auth -> existing authenticated _BoundedPool -> fixed GET Pod -> fixed GET Pod/log -> fixed GET Pod -> bounded source projection -> seal -> public evaluate_snapshot.
per_id.test_bridge_limit: The kind/check are unregistered and the production transport intentionally rejects /log. Tests locally add the exact path/query predicate, test registration, planner gate and collector invocation/union finalization; no production gate or source admission is disabled.

sample: one RFC3339(Nano) timestamp per returned line
exact fixed window and current instance timestamp bounds

per_id.identity_scope_proof: Strict selected cluster/namespace/Pod/container; actual HTTPS SDK origin and configured authorization or mTLS; native UID/RV and current instance fields must agree before/after. Only HMAC bindings are retained, never a claimed authenticated principal or effective authorization.

supported_statuses.PASS: Both pinned engines completed and found no supported secret in a nonempty, native-bound, complete returned sample and identity text; all selected rows in its scope complete.
supported_statuses.FAIL: A completed pinned detector reported a supported value in a native-bound sample or bound identity text. The other engine may be unavailable, but complete=false and remaining coverage UNKNOWN are preserved.
supported_statuses.UNKNOWN: Disabled/unnamed, empty, partial, denied, malformed, wrong type, foreign/mismatched identity/origin, changed UID/RV/restart/containerID/times/auth context, unsupported encoding, wire debug, budget exhaustion, lost redacted scope proof, or incomplete negative detector coverage.

per_id.api: GET /api/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{pod}; GET same path + /log; GET original Pod path
per_id.readiness: Ready for root review/admission of the bounded sample contract; no current production registration or hooks.
limits: Returned sample only, not full-hour/all-log absence; at most last100 lines.
No server upper time bound or atomic UID/containerID precondition on log GET; outside-window/race is UNKNOWN.
Unobserved/waiting status, omitted identity or unsupported binary/partial/empty data is UNKNOWN.
No credential validation, previous logs, exec, Secret/reference reads, node/proxy, host or external code.
Wire debug must remain disabled throughout private reads; arbitrary concurrent SDK/logging/pool reconfiguration is unsupported.

A detected value in namespace scope is redacted by the existing literal union recipe; its changed scope becomes unavailable and the strict consumer returns UNKNOWN rather than clean or falsely rebound evidence.
Busy containers returning newer-than-capture records remain UNKNOWN because the native API has no upper-time query bound.
RestartCount can reset after node restart per native schema; requiring the current containerID and start/state plus stable UID/RV adds independent observed binding but cannot make log reads atomic.

Logs can be rotated, omitted upstream or limited by native tail semantics. No complete-hour, complete-container history, secret absence outside this returned sample, credential validity, serving or effective access proof is claimed.
The sampler also scans selected identity text for union-redaction safety; a likely value there is potential exposure, not proof the application emitted it in logs.
per_id.source_mapping: New useful optional content surface; no synthetic upstream or numbered framework mapping. Existing archived criteria and source mappings are untouched.

privacy.raw_retention: Raw Pod and log bytes are bounded local temporaries only. SDK last_response is cleared, response close/release runs on success/error, and no raw text/headers/errors enter marker, ledger, cache or findings.
privacy.dedup: Existing process-random HMAC of exact UTF-8 value; cross-reader and cross-target merge preserves one value finding with multiple opaque locations, no trim/case folding and no cross-process key persistence.
privacy.union_redaction: Use new finalize() to combine literal and log ephemeral value ledgers before the existing literals.redact_output. Clear both ledgers finally; exact/plain, JSON-escaped and one base64 layer repeats in metadata are scrubbed by the existing recipe.
privacy.logging: Per-read thread-scoped filters for native Kubernetes/client/urllib3 emitters and existing output handlers, no logger-level or global debug mutations. Unrelated components/threads remain visible; overlapping contexts and exception cleanup tested.
debug_native_witness: test_actual_rest_preloaded_debug_is_a_leak_witness demonstrates native SDK preloaded response logging exposes the inert body canary.

test_native_sdk_debug_auth_body_path_privacy runs actual urllib3/http.client framing and SDK bearer headers, replacing only TCP/TLS socket; raw body/request canaries do not reach DEBUG logs or snapshot.
test_unsafe_wire_debug_fails_closed_without_global_toggles rejects SDK debug, global HTTP debug, urllib3 debug and a pooled debug-enabled connection before I/O.
privacy_limits: Arbitrary concurrent SDK/pool/logger/handler reconfiguration is outside the supported context.
Existing redaction covers exact values and documented common encodings, not arbitrary transformations or a claim to detect every possible secret.
A detected namespace is hidden but scope proof becomes unavailable, yielding UNKNOWN; this deliberate boundary matches the accepted literal scrub semantics.

Pod and current Pod log native GET routes; successful optional field absence is not invented source completeness.
